zh_CN: 「芹香没有像往常一样先调出影像。她把一份电子文档推到屏幕正中，指尖停在最后一行。」
en: 「Serika did not bring up the images first as she usually did. She moved an electronic document to the center of the screen, her fingertip resting on the final line.」

zh_CN: 「坂口医生。这份术前讨论纪要，你看过吗？」
en: 「Dr. Sakaguchi. Have you read these preoperative discussion minutes?」

zh_CN: 「早上刚发的那份？我还没来得及细看。」
en: 「The ones sent out this morning? I haven't had a chance to read them closely yet.」

zh_CN: 「那现在看。」
en: 「Then read them now.」

zh_CN: 「屏幕上的一行字被她选中。字句清清楚楚地显示出来。」
en: 「She selected a line on the screen. Every word was clearly visible.」

zh_CN: 「经影像科御園芹香医生确认，既定胆囊切除方案可按原计划实施。」
en: 「Following confirmation by Dr. Serika Misono of Radiology, the planned cholecystectomy may proceed as originally scheduled.」

zh_CN: 「……这句话是谁写的？」
en: 「...Who wrote this sentence?」

zh_CN: 「我也想知道。因为我从来没说过。」
en: 「I'd like to know that too. Because I never said it.」

zh_CN: 「你的报告我看过。你提醒过胆管走行可能有变异，还要求术中重新核对。」
en: 「I've read your report. You warned of a possible variant bile duct course and asked for it to be checked again during surgery.」

zh_CN: 「右后叶胆管的走行与常见解剖不太一样。它和胆囊管的关系，单靠这组影像还不能完全确定。」
en: 「The right posterior sectoral duct doesn't follow the usual anatomy. These images alone can't fully establish its relationship to the cystic duct.」

zh_CN: 「我写的是‘术中必须确认胆道解剖，必要时调整手术策略’。」
en: 「What I wrote was, 'Biliary anatomy must be confirmed intraoperatively, with adjustment of the surgical strategy if necessary.'」

zh_CN: 「到了纪要里，怎么就成了‘按原计划实施’？」
en: 「How did that become 'proceed as originally scheduled' in the minutes?」

zh_CN: 「而且是‘经我确认’。」
en: 「And 'following my confirmation,' at that.」

zh_CN: 「她伸手去拿桌上的笔。笔尖几乎碰到打印出来的纪要，却停住了。」
en: 「She reached for the pen on the desk. Its tip almost touched the printed minutes, then stopped.」

zh_CN: 「影像科负责说明看见了什么、还不能确定什么。是否手术、怎么做，那是外科要作的决定。」
en: 「Radiology explains what we can see and what remains uncertain. Whether to operate, and how, are decisions for Surgery to make.」

zh_CN: 「这一点我同意。」
en: 「I agree with that.」

zh_CN: 「那就请把我的名字划掉。」
en: 「Then please cross out my name.」

zh_CN: 「芹香终于抬起头。她的语气不高，却比坂口以往听过的任何一句拒绝都更硬。」
en: 「Serika finally looked up. Her voice was quiet, yet firmer than any refusal Sakaguchi had heard from her before.」

zh_CN: 「我先把原始报告和会议记录对一下。这件事不能只删一个名字就算完。」
en: 「I'll compare the original report with the meeting minutes first. We can't resolve this just by deleting a name.」

zh_CN: 「……随你。明天的手术，别让那句话跟着进手术室就行。」
en: 「...Suit yourself. Just don't let that sentence follow the patient into the operating room tomorrow.」

zh_CN: 「小夜香正把几份检查资料按顺序夹好。看见坂口和芹香一起过来，她先露出一个习惯性的笑容。」
en: 「Sayaka was clipping several sets of examination results together in order. Seeing Sakaguchi and Serika approach together, she greeted them with her usual smile.」

zh_CN: 「两位医生一起找我？什么事这么正式？」
en: 「Both of you came to see me? What's with the formal visit?」

zh_CN: 「是昨天的术前讨论纪要。最后一段，能跟我们核对一下吗？」
en: 「It's about yesterday's preoperative discussion minutes. Could you check the final paragraph with us?」

zh_CN: 「当然。那份是我整理的。」
en: 「Of course. I compiled those.」

zh_CN: 「坂口把屏幕转向她。小夜香看了两遍，笑容一点点收了起来。」
en: 「Sakaguchi turned the screen toward her. Sayaka read it twice, her smile gradually fading.」

zh_CN: 「这句话的‘确认’，指什么？」
en: 「What exactly does 'confirmation' in this sentence refer to?」

zh_CN: 「我本来是想写：御園医生已经确认了影像上的异常走行，我们可以据此把手术计划讨论下去。」
en: 「I meant to write that Dr. Misono had confirmed the abnormal course on the images, so we could use that information to continue discussing the surgical plan.」

zh_CN: 「整理成摘要的时候，我把前面那句缩掉了。结果……意思完全变了。」
en: 「When I condensed it into a summary, I cut out the first part. And... it changed the meaning completely.」

zh_CN: 「这不是省字。这是换了一个作决定的人。」
en: 「You didn't just cut words. You changed who made the decision.」

zh_CN: 「你说得对。责任在我。」
en: 「You're right. That's my responsibility.」

zh_CN: 「我记得会议上讨论得很详细。为什么最后变成了这样？」
en: 「I remember the discussion being quite detailed. How did it end up like this?」

zh_CN: 「因为大家都在说御園医生那份影像标注做得好。我当时一心想把结论写得清楚，反而把不同人的意见并到了一起。」
en: 「Everyone was praising Dr. Misono's image annotations. I was so focused on making the conclusion clear that I ended up combining different people's opinions.」

zh_CN: 「御堂医生说，这份报告连变异胆管可能影响术野的地方都标清楚了，不是光画出一条漂亮的管道。」
en: 「Dr. Mido said the report even marked where the variant bile duct might affect the operative field. It wasn't merely a nicely drawn duct.」

zh_CN: 「阿尔托莉雅医生说，有了这些提醒，外科就该把应对方案提前准备好，不能等上台才临时想办法。」
en: 「Dr. Artoria said that with these warnings, Surgery should prepare contingency plans ahead of time, rather than waiting until the operation to improvise.」

zh_CN: 「两个人都那么肯定她的判断，我脑子里就把‘影像评估很充分’和‘手术方案已经通过’连成了一件事。」
en: 「They both sounded so certain about her assessment that I conflated 'the imaging evaluation is thorough' with 'the surgical plan has been approved.'」

zh_CN: 「她们肯定的是报告。不是让你拿我的名字给术式盖章。」
en: 「They endorsed the report. They didn't authorize you to put my name on a stamp of approval for the procedure.」

zh_CN: 「是。我明白了。」
en: 「Yes. I understand.」

zh_CN: 「小夜香抽出原始报告，直接翻到芹香最后一段意见。她没再试着解释自己当时的想法。」
en: 「Sayaka pulled out the original report and turned straight to Serika's final comments. She made no further attempt to explain what she had been thinking.」

zh_CN: 「我重新写。影像提示右侧胆管走行可能存在变异，术中必须核实胆道解剖。这是御園医生的报告意见。」
en: 「I'll rewrite it. Imaging suggests a possible variant course of the right-sided bile ducts. Biliary anatomy must be verified intraoperatively. That is Dr. Misono's report opinion.」

zh_CN: 「还有，影像没法替术中确认。这句不能丢。」
en: 「And imaging cannot replace intraoperative confirmation. You mustn't leave that out.」

zh_CN: 「嗯。手术范围、处理方法，以及遇到变异时是否改变方案，由主刀医生确认。这是外科组的决定。」
en: 「Right. The extent of surgery, the technique, and whether to change the plan if a variant is encountered must be confirmed by the operating surgeon. Those are the surgical team's decisions.」

zh_CN: 「就这么写。请负责这台手术的主刀重新核对并确认，不要沿用旧版。」
en: 「Write it that way. Please have the surgeon responsible for this operation review and confirm it again. Don't carry over the old version.」

zh_CN: 「我现在就把更正说明发给参与会诊的人和手术室。已打印的术前交接单，我会去逐份换掉。原版按流程保留更正记录。」
en: 「I'll send the correction to everyone who took part in the consultation and to the operating room now. I'll replace every printed preoperative handover sheet myself. The original will be retained with a correction record according to procedure.」

zh_CN: 「御園医生，对不起。我让你的专业意见变成了你没作过的承诺。」
en: 「Dr. Misono, I'm sorry. I turned your professional opinion into a promise you never made.」

zh_CN: 「先把记录改对。病人明天就要上台。」
en: 「Correct the record first. The patient's operation is tomorrow.」

zh_CN: 「好。改完我会亲自再核一遍。」
en: 「I will. I'll check it again myself when it's done.」

zh_CN: 「芹香看着她重新打开文档，没再说什么。走出办公区时，脚步却比来时慢了一点。」
en: 「Serika watched her reopen the document without saying anything more. Yet as they left the office, her pace was a little slower than when they had arrived.」

zh_CN: 「影像室里只剩下键盘和鼠标的轻响。坂口把一份更新后的术前资料放在桌边。」
en: 「Only the soft clicks of the keyboard and mouse remained in the imaging room. Sakaguchi set a revised set of preoperative documents at the edge of the desk.」

zh_CN: 「小夜香把更正送出去了。负责这台手术的主刀也确认了修改后的方案。手术室收到的是新版。」
en: 「Sayaka has sent out the correction. The operating surgeon has also confirmed the revised plan. The operating room has the new version.」

zh_CN: 「……她动作倒快。」
en: 「...She was quick about it.」

zh_CN: 「她知道问题出在哪儿，也愿意自己收拾干净。」
en: 「She knows where she went wrong, and she's willing to put it right herself.」

zh_CN: 「我刚才对她说得太重了。」
en: 「I was too harsh with her earlier.」

zh_CN: 「那句话确实不能留。你没有无缘无故发火。」
en: 「That sentence really couldn't stay. You weren't angry for no reason.」

zh_CN: 「我没有说我不该生气。」
en: 「I didn't say I shouldn't have been angry.」

zh_CN: 「她终于转过椅子。视线落在更正后的记录上，停了很久。」
en: 「She finally turned her chair. Her gaze settled on the corrected record and stayed there for a long time.」

zh_CN: 「……我只是讨厌别人替我说话。尤其是写进正式记录以后。」
en: 「...I just hate people speaking for me. Especially once it's written into an official record.」

zh_CN: 「那就把原话留下。说了什么，是一回事；谁来决定，是另一回事。」
en: 「Then we'll keep your exact words. What was said is one thing; who makes the decision is another.」

zh_CN: 「你不是把我的名字删了吗？」
en: 「Didn't you delete my name?」

zh_CN: 「没有。影像意见还是你的，里面每一处提醒都保留了。决定怎么做手术的那一栏，写的是外科医生的名字。」
en: 「No. The imaging opinion is still yours, and every warning you gave is still there. The section deciding how to perform the surgery bears the surgeon's name.」

zh_CN: 「……这样才对。」
en: 「...That's how it should be.」

zh_CN: 「我不想抹掉你的判断，更不想让你的名字替我们承担本来不属于你的责任。」
en: 「I don't want to erase your assessment. And I certainly don't want your name carrying responsibility that belongs to us.」

zh_CN: 「芹香把新旧两份记录叠在一起。她没有再去找那支笔。」
en: 「Serika stacked the old and new records together. She did not reach for the pen again.」

zh_CN: 「我能接受自己的判断错了。错了，有证据就改。可一句没说过的话……连从哪里改起都很难。」
en: 「I can accept being wrong in my assessment. If there's evidence, I'll correct it. But words I never said... it's hard even to know where to begin correcting those.」

zh_CN: 「至少这一份已经改回来了。以后再遇到同样的事，我会先问你本人。」
en: 「At least this one has been put right. If it happens again, I'll ask you directly first.」

zh_CN: 「你最好记住。」
en: 「You'd better remember that.」

zh_CN: 「记在心里。不会写成‘经御園医生确认，坂口今后绝不犯错’。」
en: 「I'll keep it in mind. I won't write, 'Following confirmation by Dr. Misono, Sakaguchi will never make another mistake.'」

zh_CN: 「芹香愣了一下。她低下眼睛，嘴角短暂地扬起，又很快收住。」
en: 「Serika paused. She lowered her eyes, the corners of her mouth lifting briefly before settling again.」

zh_CN: 「……那句话也不归我确认。」
en: 「...That isn't for me to confirm either.」

zh_CN: 「确实。申请大概会被退回来。」
en: 「True. I suspect that application would be sent back.」

zh_CN: 「以后如果要把我的影像意见写进术前讨论，就把原始资料带来。哪里拿不准，当面问。」
en: 「If you want to include my imaging opinion in a preoperative discussion, bring the original material. Ask me face-to-face about anything you're unsure of.」

zh_CN: 「你愿意多参与一点术前讨论了？」
en: 「You're willing to take a little more part in preoperative discussions now?」

zh_CN: 「我说的是影像。别得寸进尺。」
en: 「I said imaging. Don't push your luck.」

zh_CN: 「好。影像的事，直接来问你。」
en: 「All right. I'll come straight to you about the images.」

zh_CN: 「还有，替我跟南条医生说一句。更正版写得很清楚。」
en: 「And tell Dr. Nanjo something for me. The corrected version is very clear.」

zh_CN: 「你不自己告诉她？」
en: 「Won't you tell her yourself?」

zh_CN: 「……等她下次来问片子的时候再说。」
en: 「...Next time she comes to ask about a scan.」

zh_CN: 「那我先把这一句转达了。」
en: 「Then I'll pass that along first.」

zh_CN: 「要原话。」
en: 「My exact words.」

zh_CN: 「一个字也不省。」
en: 「I won't leave out a single one.」

zh_CN: 「芹香重新面向屏幕。这一次，她没有等坂口开口，就把下一组影像调了出来。」
en: 「Serika turned back to the screen. This time, without waiting for Sakaguchi to ask, she brought up the next set of images.」

zh_CN: 「既然来了，顺便看看这个。你上次问的那条血管，我找到更清楚的层面了。」
en: 「Since you're here, take a look at this. I found a clearer slice of that vessel you asked about last time.」
「All right.」

zh_CN: 「显示器亮起。芹香把自己的椅子朝旁边挪了一点，给坂口腾出看屏幕的位置。」
en: 「The monitor lit up. Serika shifted her chair a little to one side, making room for Sakaguchi to see the screen.」
